simple.summary: בָּדָד (bâdâd) means separate ; adverb, separately First listed occurrence: Deut 32 12.

definitions.full: H910. badad בָּדָד noun [masculine] isolation, separation : Isa 27:10 בָּדָד בְּצוּרָה עִיר the fenced city is isolation , i.e. is solitary (substantive for adjective : Dr § 189. 2 ); more usually as adverb accusative, to signify alone , Deut 32:12 ; especially with verbs of dwelling, Lev 13:46 יֵשֵׁב בָּדָד he shall dwell alone (literally in isolation ), Jer 15:17 ; Lam 1:1 ; 3:28 : figurative of freedom from attack, security Deut 33:28 (of Israel), Jer 49:31 (Kedar); so לְבָדָד Num 23:9 (Israel) Micah 7:14 ; Psalm 4:9 for thou תּוֺשִׁיבֵנִי לָבֶטַח לְבָדָד makest me dwell solitarily , in safety (see Deut 33:28 ). II. בדד (probably id quod בָּדָא q. v. talk idly ).
